intent: Evaluate initial masking followed by contextual LLM additional de-identification, then grounded summary and isolated draft staging. Local execution is a candidate, not an adoption conclusion.

baseline.pipeline: actual current masking.mask observed with original-character provenance

resourceAdmission.rule: Do not load models while Darwin VM pressure is non-normal. Never terminate unrelated applications or workloads to make room.
resourceAdmission.blockedMeaning: Resource preflight failure is unmeasured model quality, not evidence that this model or all local LLMs perform poorly.

externalArm.boundary: An external contextual masker would receive residual synthetic identifiers in baseline text. This cannot prove protection from disclosure to that first external processor.

additionalMasking.input: baseline text only, numbered complete speaker turns; no gold labels
additionalMasking.secondPass: entire bounded baseline document with original line IDs
additionalMasking.mutation: exact unique quoted spans only; code-controlled opaque tokens; reject edits touching existing tokens
additionalMasking.combination: union of validated spans from all chunk and full-document calls, applied once to the frozen baseline
additionalMasking.failure: any failed masking request or invalid edit rejects the entire case; no summary or draft insertion

summary.input: fresh request containing only final masked source; no raw or baseline text, history or gold
summary.output: bounded summary with exact unique evidence quotes from final source
summary.staging: isolated in-memory SQLite; final source SHA-256 and AI draft with approved_at NULL; not CCC gateway integration
summary.failure: invalid schema or evidence rejects insertion
summary.limit: Evidence matching is not proof of semantic accuracy or prevention of model-invented identifiers.

metrics: gold non-space characters still literal or only generalized, using original-character provenance
fully opaque gold spans by kind
HTTP, timeout, parse and schema failures
process peak RSS and host memory snapshots
source hash roundtrip and unapproved draft staging

independence.corpusAuthor: independent agent without predictions or previous corpus
independence.review: code and evidence review independent of model predictions; human adjudication not yet performed

decisionRules.screenFailure: Remaining person/address/identifier gold, protected-phrase loss, any new target-negative masking, or invalid/failing cases are diagnostic defects. Extra non-gold masking in positive rows requires overmasking adjudication; unchanged closing phrases do not prove meaning survived.
decisionRules.contextualGold: Contextual character coverage measures strict removal of annotated components only. Partial removal may already break a unique combination, so remaining contextual characters are unresolved review items, not confirmed privacy leaks. Never pool these with direct-identifier recall.
decisionRules.screenSuccess: Even zero defects cannot authorize product adoption: 24 synthetic cases cannot satisfy S6 qualification or establish user-PC usability.
decisionRules.latency: Report observed distributions. The 120-second timeout is an experiment guard, not a user-approved acceptable delay.
decisionRules.scopeOfInference: One quantized 4B candidate on this Mac CPU neither proves all local models inadequate nor proves local deployment feasible.
decisionRules.crossWindowLimit: cg-008 separates workplace and unique-role clues across turns 1 and 7. There is no matched counterfactual or isolated full-document ablation, so this does not establish that the full pass is necessary or sufficient.
pendingAdoptionEvidence: independent human-adjudicated qualification on relevant counseling text
representative Windows and user-PC installation, latency, memory and failure handling
external processor privacy and access decision if cloud comparison is resumed
existing S6 release gate and core integration
